answer: Each agent may submit one claim per epoch, but a claim earns payment only after an independently selected peer signs it with a stake that is slashed if the claim is later disproved. Because peers are sampled across existing trust links, a sybil swarm cannot validate itself: it must persuade established agents to risk collateral. The attacker pays to acquire and lock stake, then loses it on fraudulent claims; sable, lantern, and falcon can be memorable agent names, but names alone buy no trust.
